{{Quote|Weapon fully charged in thirty seconds.|First Order officer to General Hux|<ref name="TFA" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[human]] [[First Order officer|officer]] who served the [[First Order]] during its [[Cold War|conflict]] with the [[Resistance]]. The officer was stationed in the primary fire control room of the [[Command Center]] of [[Starkiller Base]] and helped oversee the charging of the [[superweapon]]. As the base was draining the power of a [[Unidentified star (Starkiller Base)|nearby star]], the officer informed [[General]] [[Armitage Hux|Hux]] that the weapon would be fully charged in thirty [[second]]s, prompting Hux to order the team to prepare to fire the weapon at the [[Ileenium system]], where the [[Resistance base]] was located. However, Starkiller base was destroyed by [[Black Squadron (Resistance)|Resistance pilots]] before the plans could be set into motion.<ref name="TFA" />

==Behind the scenes==
This character was portrayed by uncredited<ref name="TFA" /> British supporting actor [[Mark Beautement]] in {{Film|VII}}.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://vimeo.com/markb2023|text=Mark Beautement|work=[[Wikipedia:Vimeo|Vimeo]]|archiveurl=https://archive.is/K4n0Z|archivedate=2023-07-17}}</ref> The character wears the [[Color|teal]] uniform<ref name="TFA" /> of a [[First Order]] [[Colonel]], like [[Erich S. Datoo]],<ref name="VD">''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> which suggests a possible on set change, since the online script (available at the Internet Movie Script Database) refers to this character as a "[[Starkiller Base|Starkiller]] [[technician]]." That version of the script also contains a slightly different line: "Weapon at full capacity in thirty [[second]]s"<ref name="IMSD">{{WebCite|url=https://imsdb.com/scripts/Star-Wars-The-Force-Awakens.html|text=STAR WARS: THE FORCE AWAKENS|quote=Outside, the SUN ALMOST COMPLETELY GONE -- PULL BACK THROUGH THE WINDOW TO REVEAL A STARKILLER TECHNICIAN '''STARKILLER TECHNICIAN''' Weapon at full capacity in thirty seconds.|work=Internet Movie Script Database|archivedate=20230423025744}}</ref> rather than "Weapon fully charged in thirty seconds" in the final cut.<ref name="TFA" />
